description: Ledger of AI recommendations, staff decisions, and actual shoot/rental outcomes for continuous intelligence refinement.

ai_recommendation.reasoning: Fast autofocus, matching S-Cinetone color profiles across both bodies, redundant wireless mic audio.

records.staff_notes: Standard wedding package that works reliably every time.

actual_outcome.client_feedback: Seamless shoot at Godavari Resort. Colors matched instantly in post.

records.learning_reflection: Validates Dual FX3A as gold standard for high-end wedding teams. No modification needed.

ai_recommendation.reasoning: High-end commercial color fidelity, zero global shutter distortion, dedicated SDI monitoring and safe caretaker handling.

records.staff_notes: Client requested Blazar Mantis Anamorphic instead of NiSi Athena primes for wider cinematic flare.

actual_outcome.client_feedback: Loved the anamorphic look. Monitor needed 1.33x de-squeeze activated.

records.learning_reflection: When client requests anamorphic glass, auto-verify that the chosen monitor firmware supports the exact de-squeeze ratio (1.33x for Mantis, 1.8x for Great Joy).

records.staff_notes: Upgraded power: Manang winter/high-altitude cold drains batteries fast. Added 1x 99Wh V-Mount + D-Tap dummy battery + silica packs.

actual_outcome.client_feedback: Temperatures hit -8C at night. Standard NP-FZ100s died in 35 mins; the V-Mount powered the time-lapse for 4 hours solid.

records.learning_reflection: RULE UPDATED: Whenever destination is Manang, Mustang, or >3000m altitude, AI MUST auto-include V-Mount cold-weather battery derating (40%) and sealed pelican thermal acclimatization SOP.

ai_recommendation.reasoning: High daylight output punch for exterior shade matching.

actual_outcome.client_feedback: Sandbags were critical—high wind gust on set on Day 2 did not topple the 600x.

records.learning_reflection: Sandbagging policy (2 bags per 600x on jumbo stand) proven 100% essential for exterior safety.

ai_recommendation.reasoning: Idle high-value lens set activation; client wanted 90s visual flare.

records.staff_notes: Idle stock movement: Great Joy set booked for 2 days at Rs 12,000/day.

actual_outcome.client_feedback: The streaks and oval bokeh were incredible. Will book again next month.

records.learning_reflection: Demonstrates successful dead-capital activation. Pairing idle anamorphic glass with FX3 and wireless monitor makes high-end cinema accessible to music video creators.
